statement.zh: 乌盖尔伊拉克古物局发掘记录了欧贝德聚落、乌鲁克彩绘神庙与早王朝墓地语境，见 Lloyd & Safar 1943。
statement.en: At Tell Uqair, Iraqi Directorate excavations recorded Ubaid settlement, an Uruk painted temple, and Early Dynastic cemetery contexts, as documented in Lloyd & Safar 1943.
